kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقتسم (form VIII)
# أَقْتَسِمُ (ʔaqtasimu) /ʔaq.ta.si.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# أَقْتَسِمَ (ʔaqtasima) /ʔaq.ta.si.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
# أَقْتَسِمْ (ʔaqtasim) /ʔaq.ta.sim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَسَمَ (iqtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
